faq.h2: Everything people ask before they build.

items.a: Genuinely free. You can build, grade, and download a PDF or Word file without creating an account or entering a card. There is no paywall at the download, no watermark to crop out, and no trial that quietly becomes a paid plan. Cvyon is funded by recruiters who pay to reach candidates who choose to opt in — never by charging the people who are looking for work.
items.q: Is Cvyon really free, or is there a paywall waiting at the download?

items.a: Every layout is ATS-friendly by construction: real selectable text (never text rendered as an image), standard section headings, a clean reading order, and none of the clever tricks that blind a parser. On top of that, the grader scores your specific résumé against a specific job post, so you can see and close the gaps before you hit apply.
items.q: Will a résumé built here get past applicant-tracking systems?

items.a: No. The builder runs in your browser and your draft is saved locally on your own device. An account is purely optional — it only exists so you can keep several résumés and pick them up on another device. You can finish and download your work without ever signing in.
items.q: Do I need to create an account to use it?

items.a: When you grade a résumé, your résumé text and the job description are sent to our AI to compute a match score, then they leave the prompt flow. We do not sell your résumé. Joining the talent pool is a separate, explicit choice you can reverse at any time, and you can export or permanently delete everything we hold about you whenever you like.
items.q: How does the AI grader work, and what happens to my data?

items.a: Yes. In addition to a pixel-perfect PDF, you can instantly download your résumé as a highly structured, editable .docx file that opens cleanly in Word, Google Docs, and Apple Pages.
